comment: Downcall stubs for ForeignPty's libc calls. GraalVM generates one automatically only where it
can constant-fold the FunctionDescriptor at the Linker.downcallHandle call site, and a static
final field is NOT constant to the builder unless its holder was initialized during the
build. ForeignPty must not be -- see native-image.properties in this directory -- so every
descriptor is registered here by hand. Without this the build succeeds and the binary dies on
first PTY use with MissingForeignRegistrationError.
One entry per distinct descriptor, not per symbol, because registration is keyed on the
descriptor. In ForeignPty's order:
open       int (void*, int)
grantpt    int (int)          -- shared with unlockpt and close
unlockpt   int (int)
ptsname_r  int (int, void*, long)
ioctl      int (int, long, void*), firstVariadicArg 2
read       long (int, void*, long)  -- shared with write
write      long (int, void*, long)
close      int (int)
Add a downcall whose shape is not already listed and you must add it here too; the build will
not tell you, only the running binary will.
Per-entry 'reason' strings are in the published schema and are REJECTED by the 25.0.2 parser
('Unknown attribute(s) [reason] in foreign call'), which is why this explanation is one
top-level comment instead of sitting on each entry.
